$sources: ASCE 7-22 Sec 26.6 (Kd), 26.7 (exposure), 26.8 (topography), 26.9 (ground elevation factor Ke, taken 1.0), 26.10 (velocity pressure), 26.11 (gust effects), 26.13 (internal pressure)

ASCE 7-22 Chapters 27-30: the pressure coefficients of the MWFRS (directional Ch 27, envelope Ch 28) and of components and cladding (Ch 30) that ASCE 7-22 shares with the earlier editions are inherited from the BNBC 2020 tables (BNBC Sec 2.4 follows ASCE 7-05 Ch 6); see VERIFY.md for what differs
source: ASCE 7-22 Chapters 26-30 (terrain constants of Table 26.11-1; coefficients the editions share inherited from bnbc2020)

B.description: Exposure B: urban and suburban areas, wooded areas, closely spaced obstructions

C.description: Exposure C: open terrain with scattered obstructions, grasslands

D.description: Exposure D: flat unobstructed areas and water surfaces (shorelines, mud flats, ice)

sources.defaultExposure: ASCE 7-22 Sec 26.7.3: Exposure C applies where Exposure B or D does not, so a new project starts in C (choose the site's own exposure in Project Settings > Wind)
sources.exposures: ASCE 7-22 Sec 26.7 and Table 26.11-1: alpha 7.5, 9.8, 11.5 and zg 3280, 2460, 1935 ft (999.7, 749.8, 589.8 m); the gust constants c, l, epsilon-bar, alpha-bar, b-bar, zmin as the earlier editions
sources.kzFactor: ASCE 7-22 Table 26.10-1 note: Kz = 2.41 (z/zg)^(2/alpha), z at least 15 ft (4.57 m)
sources.directionality: ASCE 7-22 Table 26.6-1: buildings, MWFRS and C&C, Kd = 0.85 (applied in the pressures; the product is the same)
sources.gust: ASCE 7-22 Sec 26.11.4: G = 0.85 for rigid buildings
sources.topography: ASCE 7-22 Sec 26.8.1-26.8.2, Figure 26.8-1: K1/(H/Lh), gamma and mu; H at least 60 ft (18.3 m) in exposure B and 15 ft (4.5 m) in C and D
sources.elevation: ASCE 7-22 Sec 26.9: Ke = 1.0 (permitted for all sites; not applied otherwise)
sources.designCases: ASCE 7-22 Sec 27.3.5 and Figure 27.3-8 (design wind load cases)
sources.flexible: ASCE 7-22 Sec 26.11.5 (flexible or dynamically sensitive buildings, Gf)
sources.internalPressure: ASCE 7-22 Sec 26.13, Table 26.13-1 (GCpi by enclosure classification)
sources.mwfrs: ASCE 7-22 Chapter 27 (directional procedure, Figure 27.3-1) and Chapter 28 (envelope procedure, Figure 28.3-1); coefficients as the extended pack gives them (see VERIFY.md)
sources.cladding: ASCE 7-22 Chapter 30 (components and cladding): walls Figure 30.3-1; roofs by the coefficients the extended pack gives (the ASCE 7-05 values; ASCE 7-16 and 7-22 revised the roof zones, see VERIFY.md)
sources.openStructures: ASCE 7-22 Chapter 29 (other structures: Sec 29.4, open signs, lattice frameworks and trussed towers)
